analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive session. RSI rose from 47.7 to 57.7 but remains in the neutral range. MACD histogram shows improvement but stays negative. 5-day and 20-day highs/lows are identical, and the price is consolidating around the Bollinger Band middle line. Volume surged to 2.01 times the 5-day average, but lacks directional conviction.

[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (47.7→57.7) + 중립 구간 횡보 중, 상승 방향성 확인
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.0010→-0.0006) + 개선 진단, 약세 전환 신호 미약
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 $0.08) + 밴드폭 16.04%로 변동성 보통 수준 해석
[지지·저항 구조]

· 스윙 저항선 ($0.09) + 돌파 시 의미 (현재가와 동일, 피벗 R1 $0.10)
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보) + 추세 전환 신호 미약
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (2.01배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 상승
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 관망 조건 유지
analysis.narrativeEn:

· SMA100/200($0.08/$0.09) relative position: neutral level for mid-long term trend strength
· 52-week position (9.3%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.7→57.7) + consolidating in neutral range, confirming upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0010→-0.0006) + improving diagnosis, weak signal for trend reversal
· Bollinger Band current price position (middle line $0.08) + band width 16.04% interpreted as moderate volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance ($0.09) + significance upon breakout (same as current price, Pivot R1 $0.10)

· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase) + maintaining wait-and-see conditions
